seo_title: Bellow: Mac App Design and Build | The Brandle
summary: A push-to-talk dictation app for the Mac that transcribes on the device, with no cloud and no account.

brief.label: Mac app
brief.heading: The idea
paras: Bellow is push-to-talk dictation for the Mac. Hold a key, speak, let go. Your words land wherever the cursor is.
The transcription happens on the Mac itself. No cloud, no account, no recordings sent anywhere. Fingers are slower than tongues, and that is nobody else's business.

answer.label: Mac app
answer.heading: The build
paras: Built by Muteeb, one of our founders, who got tired of typing. The app, the brand and the site at bellow.dev were all made in-house.

It works in any app, and it needs an Apple Silicon Mac. Transcripts are saved on your machine and encrypted. One switch wipes the history and stops new ones being kept, which is there for lawyers, doctors and journalists.
The site has a section called "Private? We can prove it." We rather liked writing that.
